payload.decision: Confirm H025/T033: E011 residual actions occupy a compact outer-training manifold with sub-5 hidden-label capacity. Select H026/T034 as the immediate legal-identifiability and privileged-geology mediation gate.
payload.rationale: T031 rejects direct latent formation-displacement recovery and T032 rejects registered analog identity, but T033 separates representation from selection and passes every capacity gate. PCA rank 8 reaches 2.1613289429 RMSE with 100% positive wells and robust legacy/horizon groups; rank 16 reaches 0.9389753196. T034 now tests whether legal observations identify the seven-dimensional action target and whether train-only formation displacement explains any remaining gap.
payload.revisit_trigger: Do not implement, package, run on Kaggle, or submit a PCA/action-manifold model unless T034 legal identifiability passes. A strong privileged-geology result is causal diagnostic evidence only and never authorizes unavailable columns at inference.
payload.title: Confirm compact residual manifold and test legal coordinate identification
